chunks: Indeed, in that are signs for those who discern.
He said: They are the Imams (عليهم السلام).
The Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) said: Beware of the discernment of the believer, for he looks by the light of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.
Concerning the saying of Allah, the Exalted: Indeed, in that are signs for those who discern.

key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةُ: the Imams, identified here as the referent of the verse
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِ: the believer whose perception is illuminated
key_terms.الْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ: those who discern signs and perceive with insight
key_terms.بِنُورِ اللَّهِ: by the light of Allah, meaning divinely granted insight

ai.seo_question: Who are the ones meant by "those who discern" in Qur'an 15:75 according to Imam Abu Ja'far (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This report explains the Qur'anic phrase about those who discern as referring to the Imams (عليهم السلام). It also cites a saying of the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) about the believer's insight being through the light of Allah, linking spiritual discernment to divine guidance.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazan, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Rabie Bin Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [15:75] Surely, in this are Signs for the distinguishers (of the marks).
Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Fear the discernment of the Momin, for he looks by a Light of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
in the Words of Allahazwj the Exalted [15:75] Surely, in this are Signs for the distinguishers (of the marks)’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Isma‘il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Hammad ibn ’Isa from Rib’i ibn ‘Abdallah from Muhammad ibn Muslim from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following about the words of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High. “In this there is evidence (of the Truth) for the distinguished ones.” [15:75]
“The Imam (a.s.) said, “The distinguished people are the Imams (a.s.)
the Holy Prophet has said, “Be on your guard from the intelligence of the believers. He lookss through the light of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High
as mentioned in, “In this there is evidence (of the Truth) for the distinguished ones.” [15:75]
